changelog: New: Teleprompter. Read your script right under the camera at the pace you set. Free for scripts up to 300 words; Pro removes the limit and hides the notch from screen shares and recordings.
With the notch pinned open, the screen around it now takes clicks again.
The notch clock now always matches the Windows clock.
New: Restart Smart Notch, in the tray icon's menu and in Settings, for when the notch stops responding.
Closing Smart Notch can no longer leave it hanging.
On a side notch, the music view's empty-lyrics message no longer covers the playback controls.
